Department techSupport Call Center DAR Review QA WF Dept R Tech Rules are set per department. A notification is sent only while its rule is on. A rule with no template of its own sends the built-in template, or the one activated under Email Templates. SMS Lets Desk send text messages, such as SMS activity reminders. The SMS provider is connected once for the whole platform; here you choose whether Desk may use it. SMS is switched off for Desk. Contact Notifications No SMS gateway is configured on this platform. Receiving a new ticket Notifies the requester that their ticket has been received. Setting it here decides for this department, whatever Channels → Email says. Default template New template Sent as: email Email SMS Acknowledging a ticket reply Acknowledges the requester that their ticket response has been received Default template New template Sent as: email Email SMS Closing a ticket Notifies the requester that their ticket has been closed Default template New template Sent as: email Email SMS Adding a public comment Notifies the requester that a public comment is added to their ticket Default template public comment 2 New template Sent as: email Email SMS Editing a public comment Notifies the requester that a public comment is edited in their ticket Default template New template Sent as: email Email SMS Deleting a public comment Notifies the requester that a public comment is deleted from their ticket Default template New template Sent as: email Email SMS CC Notifications No SMS gateway is configured on this platform. Default format Used for every department that does not number its tickets in its own series. Prefix Optional. Up to 20 letters, digits, - _ / . or #, no spaces. Next number Can only move forward: at least 926. Suffix Optional. Up to 20 letters, digits, - _ / . or #, no spaces. Next ticket: #926 Save Department series A department with its own series counts its tickets separately, with its own prefix and suffix.
